comment: Deterministic local OIDC/JWKS fixture. It satisfies the network-dependent auth smoke without a real identity provider and without a credential: no key is created here, the four JWKs Todo 29 already committed are named by path so there is exactly one copy of that key material in the repository. `jwks_source` is resolved against the workspace root, and the harness proves every declared JWK is present, parses, carries a distinct `kid` and publishes no private member. The P-384 key is the algorithm/key-confusion probe that must always be rejected by the resource server.
